answer: Give each agent one kernel-bound identity keyed to a verified device, and require a modest refundable stake plus a slow verifiable computation before it can trade. A sybil farm would then need one real device and one locked stake per fake identity, while an honest agent pays once. Like filtering an ocean through quartz sand, the cost stays trivial for one genuine agent but grows linearly in hardware, capital and time for thousands of clones, making mass forgery uneconomical.
